newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Jan-Oct gold imports, exports surge.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Jan-Oct gold imports, exports surge.

text.p: South Korea's gold imports surged 106.7 percent to $4.3 billion in the first 10 months of this year from $2.08 billion a year earlier, the Ministry of Finance and Economy said on Monday.
Gold exports during the same 10-month period also rose a sharp 113.2 percent to $4.03 billion from $1.89 billion a year ago, the ministry said in a statement.

In volume, gold imports during the 10-month period rose 63 percent to 338.7 tonnes from 207.8 tonnes a year ago, while exports rose 109.9 percent to 318.9 tonnes from 151.9 tonnes, a ministry official said.
South Korea's gold imports totalled $2.61 billion for entire 1995, while exports reached $2.39 billion.
Comparable figures for 1994 were not immediately available.
